description: GFEX-EEG cohort-specific FNO-tuned weight sets. See README 'Validation & Accuracy' and Tier 2 sections.

LEMON_Polhemus_Adult.description: LEMON cohort (ds000221): Polhemus per-subject digitization, adult population. Default weights for general-purpose deployment when no hardware-specific preset is available. A residual-correction MLP (trained on LEMON HTJ GT) is available via mlp_correction=true for Tier 1.5 accuracy.

WH_Neuromag70_Adult.description: Wakeman-Henson Face Recognition cohort (ds000117-ds002718, Neuromag/Elekta 70-ch EasyCap, older adults). Dataset required forensic re-pairing (original BIDS shipped subject<->EEG scrambled; N=15 after sub-01 orphan exclusion). Apply cohort='WH_Neuromag70_Adult' with mlp_correction=true for Neuromag 70-ch Polhemus-digitized data.

tuning.note: Uses LEMON-tuned rho/beta/D_standard (pure geodesic shared with LEMON). Cohort-specific learning lives in the MLP.
tuning.gt_landmark: HTJ (manually tagged in MRI.SCS.LPA/RPA after biological head-width fingerprint rescue)

mlp.hp_selection: LeaveOneOut CV on N=10 training pool; best of 7 configs
excluded_subjects: sub-01 (orphan MRI, no matching EEG in ds002718)

CapTrak_Adult.note: Public CapTrak datasets ds007353 (HAD, N=27) and ds005811-ds005810 (NOD, N=19) ship packed electrodes.tsv files (single EEG input replicated across all subjects). A cohort-specific tune requires a fresh CapTrak dataset with genuine per-subject digitization.

EGI_HydroCel_256_Adult.note: OK cohort (ds006525, EGI HydroCel 256ch with ~25 mm cap standoff) gives ~22 mm error with LEMON-tuned weights. Dedicated tune pending a dataset with MRI ground truth.

Neuroscan_SynAmps_Adult.note: Reserved. Awaiting community contribution or internal tuning on a Neuroscan cohort with MRI.

contribution.how_to_add: Tune via geodesic_fno_tuner (MATLAB) or GeodesicTuner (Python) on a pilot subset with MRI HTJ ground truth, then submit a PR adding a new entry to weight_sets with status='production' and a full 'tuning' block. Minimum quality bar: N_training >= 5, N_holdout >= 5, held-out error under the threshold appropriate for the hardware class (see README).
contribution.documentation: See README 'Tier 2: Metaheuristic Tuning Mode' section.
